questions.question: If 2P = 3Q = 5R and P + Q + R = 6200, then the difference between P and R is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2P = 3Q = 5R

P + Q + R = 6200

**Concept or Formula:**

Use the given equations to express P, Q, and R in terms of a common variable.

Substitute these expressions into the second given equation to solve for the common variable.

Then calculate the values of P and R using the common variable.

The difference between P and R can be found by subtracting the smaller value from the larger one.

questions.question: From places A to B, which are 50 km apart, T covers half of the distance in 20 minutes. What should be his speed (in km/h) in the second half so that his average speed from A to B is 80 km/h?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 50 km

Half the distance covered in 20 minutes

Average speed = 80 km/h

**Concept:**

Average speed = Total Distance/Total Time

**Solution:**

Total time = 50 km/80 km/h = 0.625 hours = 37.5 minutes

Time left for the second half = 37.5 minutes - 20 minutes = 17.5 minutes = 0.2917 hours

Speed in the second half = Distance/Time = 25 km/0.2917 hours = 85.7 km/h

**Therefore, the speed in the second half should be 85.7 km/h.**

questions.question: A buys 150 gm gold for Rs.6,00,000 and gives 6% as making charges. What should be the selling price per 10 gm to have a profit of 6%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost of 150 gm gold = Rs.6,00,000

Making charges = 6%

Desired profit = 6%

**Concept:**

Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price

**Solution:**

Total cost = cost of gold + making charges = Rs.6,00,000 + 6% of Rs.6,00,000 = Rs.6,36,000

Selling price for 150 gm to get 6% profit = 1.06 × Rs.6,36,000 = Rs.6,74,160

Selling price per 10 gm = Rs.6,74,160 / 15 = Rs.44,944

**Therefore, the selling price per 10 gm should be Rs.44,944 to have a profit of 6%.**

questions.question: The population of a country increases by 8% in the first year, depreciates by 10% in the second year, and again increases by 6% in the third year. If the present population is 6 crore, find the population growth after 3 years.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial population = 6 crore

Population change: +8%, -10%, +6%

**Concept:**

Compound percentage change

**Solution:**

Population after first year = 6 × 1.08 = 6.48 crore

Population after second year = 6.48 × 0.9 = 5.832 crore

Population after third year = 5.832 × 1.06 = 6.18192 crore

The current population is 6 crore, Hence total increase, 

⇒ 6.18192 - 6 = 18,19,200

**Therefore, the population growth after 3 years will be 18,19,200.**

questions.question: A lady spends 20 percent of her total income on house rent, and 75 percent of the rest on household items. If she saves Rs. 600, then what is her income?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

20% of the total income is spent on house rent.

75% of the remaining income is spent on household items.

Savings = Rs. 600

**Formula Used:**

Total income = x

Income after spending on house rent = x - 0.20x

Income spent on household items = 0.75 * (remaining income)

Savings = remaining income - income spent on household items

**Calculation:**

Total income = x

Income after spending on house rent = x - 0.20x = 0.80x

Income spent on household items = 0.75 × 0.80x = 0.60x

Savings = 0.80x - 0.60x

Savings = 0.20x

Given savings = Rs. 600

0.20x = 600

**Solving the equation:**

x = 600 / 0.20

x = 3000

**Therefore, her total income is Rs. 3000.**

questions.question: Due to delay in submission of an assignment the marks of Suhani were decreased by 10 percent and she got 135 marks. What could have been her marks in the assignment, if there was no delay in submission?
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

Marks after 10% decrease = 135

**Concept:**

Percentage increase

**Solution:**

Original marks = 135 / (1 - 0.10) = 150

**Therefore, her marks could have been 150 if there was no delay in submission.**

questions.question: An aeroplane flies along the four sides of a square field at the speeds of 150 km/h, 300 km/h, 450 km/h and 600 km/h. Find the average speed of the plane around the field.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the side of the square field be the LCM of given speeds, i.e., LCM(150, 300, 450, 600) = 1800 km.

Total Distance = 4 × 1800 = 7200 km.

Total Time = (1800 ÷ 150) + (1800 ÷ 300) + (1800 ÷ 450) + (1800 ÷ 600) = 12 + 6 + 4 + 3 = 25 hours.

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = 7200 ÷ 25 = 288 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 288 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speeds along the four sides of a square field are 150 km/h, 300 km/h, 450 km/h and 600 km/h.

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the distance of each side of the square be d km.

⇒ Total Distance around the field = d + d + d + d = 4d km.

⇒ Total Time taken = (d ÷ 150) + (d ÷ 300) + (d ÷ 450) + (d ÷ 600)

⇒ Taking LCM of 150, 300, 450 and 600, which is 1800.

⇒ Total Time = (12d + 6d + 4d + 3d) ÷ 1800

⇒ Total Time = 25d ÷ 1800 = d ÷ 72 hours.

⇒ Average Speed = 4d ÷ (d ÷ 72)

⇒ Average Speed = 4 × 72 = 288 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 288 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Two Equal Distances

When a person covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed is given by (2xy) ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed for Three Equal Distances

When a person covers three equal distances at speeds x, y and z, the average speed is given by (3xyz) ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Average Speed for Unequal Distances

If distances d₁, d₂, d₃... are covered at speeds v₁, v₂, v₃... respectively, the average speed is (d₁ + d₂ + d₃...) ÷ (t₁ + t₂ + t₃...).

questions.question:
The average of the following numbers is 25. Find the value of X.

24, 30, 12, 18, 20, 10, 40, X
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of numbers = 25

Total numbers = 8

Numbers = 24, 30, 12, 18, 20, 10, 40, X

**Concept:**

Average = Total Sum/Number of Values

**Solution:**

Sum of given numbers = 24 + 30 + 12 + 18 + 20 + 10 + 40 = 154

Total sum of numbers = Average × Total numbers = 25 × 8 = 200

Value of X = Total sum - Sum of given numbers = 200 - 154 = 46

**Therefore, the value of X is 46.**

questions.question: A class teacher conducted a unit test in the class. If out of 30 students, 14 students scored 80 and rest 16 students scored 65, then what is the weighted average score?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the deviation method with assumed average = 65:

Deviation of 14 students = 80 − 65 = +15

Total deviation = 14 × 15 = +210

Average deviation for all 30 students = +210 ÷ 30 = +7

Weighted average = 65 + 7 = 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Weighted Average

questions.question: The remainder when 3²⁷ is divided by 26?
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

Dividend = 3²⁷

Divisor = 26

**Concept or Formula:**

Using modular arithmetic and properties of powers can simplify,

The process of finding the remainder when a large number is divided by a smaller one.

**Solution:**

The goal is to find a smaller number that is equivalent to 3²⁷ (mod 26), i.e., has the same remainder when divided by 26.

Note that 3³ = 27 ≡ 1 (mod 26), which means 27 leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by 26.

Using this, we can express 3^27 as (3³)⁹,

Because raising to the power of 9 doesn't change the remainder when divided by 26 (it's still 1).

So, 3²⁷ ≡ 1⁹ ≡ 1 (mod 26).

**Therefore, the remainder when 3²⁷ is divided by 26 is 1.**

questions.question: The product of 2 numbers is 1890 and the numbers differ by 3. Find the LCM of the numbers.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Product of numbers = 1890

Difference of numbers = 3

**Solution:**

Let numbers be x and x + 3

Product gives x(x + 3) = 1890

⇒ x² + 3x - 1890 = 0

⇒ x2 + 45x - 42x - 1890 = 0

⇒ x (x + 45) - 42 (x + 45) = 0

⇒ (x + 45) (x - 42) = 0 

⇒ x = -45, 42

The number can not be negative, hence,

⇒ x = 42 and x + 3 = 42 + 3 = 45

Prime factorize the two numbers.

⇒ 45 = 3 × 3 × 5

⇒ 42 = 2 × 3 × 7

LCM of 45 and 42 

⇒ 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 7 = 630 

**Therefore, the LCM of the numbers is 630.**

questions.question: A and B alone take 4 and 6 hours, respectively, to complete a certain work. If they work alternatively each hour, starting with A first, how long will it take them to complete the work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A's time = 4 hours

B's time = 6 hours

**Concept:**

Work and Time calculations

**Solution:**

In one hour, A completes 1/4 of the work and B completes 1/6 of the work.

Together in two hours, they complete 1/4 + 1/6 of the work.

⇒ Combined work in 2 hours = 1/4 + 1/6

⇒ Combined work in 2 hours = (6 + 4) / 24 = 10 / 24 = 5 / 12 of the work

Every two hours, they complete 5/12 of the work.

⇒ Therefore, in four hours, they will complete 2 × 5/12 = 10/12 = 5/6 of the work.

After four hours, it's A's turn and A can complete the remaining 1/6 of the work in (1/6) × 4 = 2/3 hours.

Total time = 4 + 2/3 ={{14} over 3} hours.

**∴ Total time taken is ​{{14} over 3}** **hours.**

questions.question: Seema purchased a boat that cost her for Rs.3200 and marked price is Rs.4000. How much discount she get ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price = Rs. 3200

Marked price = Rs. 4000

**Concept:**

Discount = Marked price - Cost price

**Solution:**

Discount = Rs. 4000 - Rs. 3200 = Rs. 800

**Therefore, she gets a discount of Rs. 800.**

questions.question: The marked price of a product is Rs. 1000. If it is sold at 7 percent discount and the dealer earns 50 percent profit, then what is the cost price of the product?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs.1000

Discount = 7%

Profit = 50%

**Concept:**

Cost Price = Selling price / (1 + Profit%)

**Solution:**

Selling price = Marked price × (1 - Discount%) = Rs.1000 × (1 - 0.07) = Rs.930

Cost price = Selling price / (1 + Profit%) = Rs.930 / (1 + 0.5) = Rs.620

**Therefore, the cost price of the product is Rs.620.**

questions.question: Find the compound interest on Rs.1,000 at 20% per annum for one year if interest is compounded half-yearly.
questions.solution:

Principal = Rs.1,000

Rate = 20% per annum

Time = 1 year

Compounded half-yearly

**Concept:**

Compound Interest formula when compounded half-yearly,

A = P(1 + r/2n)⁽²ⁿt⁾

**Solution:**

Amount after 1 year = Rs.1,000(1 + 0.20/2)⁽²×¹⁾ = Rs.1,210

Compound interest = Amount - Principal = Rs.1,210 - Rs.1,000 = Rs.210

**Therefore, the compound interest is Rs.210.**

questions.question: If {{a} over 6} = {{b} over 10} = {{c} over 4} then {{a + b + c} over a} is equal to :
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

(a/6) = (b/10) = (c/4)

**Solution:**

If all three ratios are equal, 

we can say a ∶ 6 = b ∶ 10 = c ∶ 4

Thus, a/6 = b/10 = c/4 ⇒ a = 6k, b = 10k, c = 4k for some constant k

Substituting these values into the second equation,

⇒ (a + b + c) / a = (6k + 10k + 4k) / 6k = 20/6 = 10/3

**Therefore, (a + b + c) / a = 10/3.**

questions.question: By selling 50 fruits, a fruit seller gains the selling price of 10 fruits. Find the gain percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number of fruits sold = 50

Gain = Selling price of 10 fruits

**Concept:**

Gain% = (Gain/Cost Price) × 100

**Solution:**

If gain is equal to the selling price of 10 fruits,

the cost price will be the selling price of remaining 40 fruits.

Gain% = (Selling price of 10 fruits / Selling price of 40 fruits) × 100 = 25%

**Therefore, the gain percentage is 25%.**
